decision_relevant.reason: existing cost model is scale-dependent (per-share commission_per_share=0.003 and slippage_cents=2.0); under constant-notional sizing it drives the matched coin-flip null into insolvency for low-priced split-adjusted series (NVDA OOS start equity < 0), after which total_return=end/start-1 is a negative/negative ratio whose reported positive value is an accounting artifact; this inflates null dispersion and makes REGIME_STABLE trivially achievable, so the predeclared cost-robustness classification is not decision-grade.

instrument_audit.note: negative OOS equity (insolvency) makes total_return=end/start-1 a ratio of two negative numbers; the reported positive return is an accounting artifact, not a profit
